units.source_text: 我还记得五月八日的日记是这样写的：“

en.t: I still remember that the diary entry for May 8 was written like this: "

units.source_text: 我面对桌子，把稿纸展开。

en.t: I sat facing the desk and spread out the manuscript paper.

units.source_text: 美代则坐在那里，准备恭听那番所谓的心里话。

en.t: Miyo sat there, ready to listen respectfully to those so-called innermost thoughts.

units.source_text: （我想原原本本地记录祖父的话。）

en.t: (I wanted to record Grandfather's words exactly as they were.)

units.source_text: ”家里是有“桌子”的，不过我记得在替代桌子的脚蹬儿（脚搭子）的一头，

en.t: "There was indeed a "desk" at home, but I remember that at one end of the footstool that served as my desk,

units.source_text: 立着一根蜡烛，我就是在那上面写了《十六岁的日记》。

en.t: a single candle was standing, and it was on that very surface that I wrote Diary of a Sixteen-Year-Old.

units.source_text: 祖父双目近乎失明，他也没觉察到我在记着写生式的日记。

en.t: Grandfather was almost blind in both eyes, and he did not notice that I was keeping a diary in a sketch-like style.
